title: duranta repens f. serrata
intro: Duranta repens f. serrata, commonly known as 'Gold Mound', is a flowering plant species in the family Verbenaceae. This plant is valued for its attractive golden foliage and vibrant blue flowers, which not only add aesthetic appeal to gardens but also provide several health benefits. The health benefits of Duranta repens f. serrata include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been isolated and studied for their potential medicinal properties.
